answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve a 1-unit capacity slot in a secure harbor, acting as an anchor for verified occupancy. An honest agent pays for its singular, exclusive reservation, while 1,000 fakes must incur immense, concurrent operational costs to maintain parallel capacity, rising like a lonely knoll in a desert of noise. A verifier audits session heartbeat pulses against a smooth marble surface of records; any evidence of an overlap triggers immediate, irreversible privilege revocation, and no refund is ever provided to the malicious identity.
